world-kettlehold.md: Kettlehold is the last town before the summit of the Ashbell Pass.
The Kettle & Coal stands on the edge of Saltgate, so its back door opens straight onto the market stalls.
The Old Mine has been sealed since the Night of Ash.
Locals call the high road “the Kettle’s Spout” because steam rises from every crack in it.
lore-the-ashbell.md: Whoever rings the *Ashbell* loses their voice until the next sunrise.
On the Night of Ash, ten winters before Ves came home, Aldous Ashdown died ringing the Ashbell.
The Night of Ash buried the lower town of Kettlehold in a single night.
lore-ember-well.md: The Ember Well grants Ashsight only to those who drink from it before dawn.
Ashsight lets its bearer see the heat left behind by footsteps for about a day.
Only the Order of the Quiet Flame may draw water from the Ember Well.
codex-factions.md: Abbess Hesper Quill leads the Order of the Quiet Flame from Stillfire Abbey.
Captain Rourke Dale commands the Pass Guard from the barracks beside the Bell Gate.
The Red Mule Caravan carries salt and lamp oil up the pass twice a year.
The Pass Guard answers to the Abbess in matters of fire and to no one in matters of snow.
codex-roads.md: The walk from the Bell Gate to Saltgate takes forty-five minutes — longer in snow.
The climb from the Cinder Bridge to Stillfire Abbey takes twenty minutes on the switchback stair.
On Day 0, the Red Mule Caravan makes camp at the Foot of the Pass.
The Cinder Bridge spans the steam gorge between Kiln Street and the Abbey stair.
codex-items-abilities.md: The Bronze Clapper weighs as much as a grown goat and hangs from a chain of black iron.
The Cinder Key is a *warm* iron key that never cools, even in snow.
The Cinder Key opens any door sealed by the Order of the Quiet Flame.
Ashsight fades if its bearer sleeps before the trail is followed.
codex-characters.md: Ves Calloway is a caravan scout for the Red Mule Caravan, coming home to Kettlehold after six years away.
Corin Ashdown is the Bellwarden of Kettlehold and the keeper of the Ashbell.
Ysolde Marr is the captain of the Red Mule Caravan and has never lost a mule to the pass.
Ysolde and Corin were sworn partners until 18:00 on Day 2, when Ysolde broke the oath in front of the Bell Gate.
Captain Rourke Dale has served in the Pass Guard for nineteen winters.
Abbess Hesper Quill is ninety years old and has not left Stillfire Abbey since the Night of Ash.
Aldous Ashdown was Corin's father and the Bellwarden before him.
codex-npc-schedules.md: Mother Brisk is the innkeeper of the Kettle & Coal and has fed every caravan that has crossed the pass in thirty years.
At 18:00 on Day 3, Mother Brisk is behind the bar of the Kettle & Coal, as she is every evening.
At 07:30 on Day 4, Mother Brisk is at Saltgate buying the week's salt.
Odo Fenn is the lamplighter of Kettlehold and has lit its lamps since he was nine.
Tamsin Wick is a sixteen-year-old courier who runs messages between Kettlehold and Stillfire Abbey.
S01-homecoming.md: At 16:00 on Day 1, Ves rides through the Bell Gate at the head of the Red Mule Caravan.
S02-dusk-at-the-bell-gate.md: At 19:00 on Day 1, Corin rings the Ashbell and the whole valley holds its breath.
Corin shouts a warning down to the Pass Guard the moment the last note fades.
S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md: At 20:00 on Day 1, Ves takes the corner table at the Kettle & Coal.
Mother Brisk pours Ves a cup of pine tea and refuses her coin.
The lamps on Kiln Street go dark at midnight, every night, without fail.
"Not tonight," Brisk says. "Not with ash in the wind."
S04-embers-and-oaths.md: Ysolde asks Corin to leave the Cinder Bridge open after dusk, just once.
S05-the-silent-bell.md: At dusk on Day 2, the Ashbell swings but makes no sound at all.
From 21:00 to 22:00 on Day 2, Captain Rourke stands watch at the Bell Gate and sees no one climb the tower.
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md: At 21:30 on Day 2, Captain Rourke is drinking alone at the Kettle & Coal.
At 22:00 on Day 2, the Lamplighter is on the Cinder Bridge, trimming the last wick.
The Lamplighter keeps a tally of every lamp he has lit, scratched into the lining of his coat.
He climbs the Tallow Stair with his ladder over one shoulder.
S07-the-ember-well.md: At 05:00 on Day 3, Ves kneels at the Ember Well and drinks before the sky turns grey.
The water burns going down, and when Ves opens her eyes she has Ashsight.
Abbess Hesper Quill gives Ves the Cinder Key and tells her to bring it back before the bell rings again.
Ves sees the heat of a footprint glow for a heartbeat and then fade.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md: At 09:00 on Day 3, Tamsin is waiting at the Cinder Bridge with a message from the Abbey.
The heat trail leads from the Bell Gate tower down Kiln Street toward the Old Mine.
S09-the-old-mine.md: Ves turns the Cinder Key and the sealed door of the Old Mine sighs open.
The sign-in board shows that Odo Fenn was at the Old Mine at 22:00 on Day 2.
Wrapped in sacking behind the ore carts lies the Bronze Clapper.
At 14:00 on Day 3, Ves is back at the Bell Gate with the clapper wrapped in her cloak.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md: At 14:10 on Day 3, Ves is pushing through the crowd at Saltgate, looking for Ysolde.
Around evening on Day 3, Mother Brisk is at Saltgate haggling over a barrel of ember salt.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md: At 06:00 on Day 4, Ves rings the Ashbell herself, and the sound rolls all the way down to the Foot of the Pass.
S12-the-broken-oath.md: At 08:00 on Day 4, Ysolde's sworn partner, Corin, meets her at the foot of the Bell Gate stairs.
Ysolde admits she paid Odo Fenn to take the Bronze Clapper.
S13-voiceless.md: At noon on Day 4, Ves still cannot speak a single word.
S14-the-long-road-down.md: On Day 5, Ves climbs to Stillfire Abbey to return the Cinder Key.
At 10:00 on Day 5, Ves stands at the Bell Gate and watches the Red Mule Caravan go.
quest-the-silent-bell.md: The Silent Bell is given by Corin when the dusk bell fails on Day 2.
The Silent Bell is the main quest of Act 2 and cannot be skipped.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md: Odo Fenn owes Ysolde forty silver marks from a bad winter at the Foot of the Pass.
A Debt in Salt is given by Mother Brisk once the player has eaten at the Kettle & Coal.
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md: At 09:12 on Day 3, Tamsin is at the gate of Stillfire Abbey, out of breath.
The Well Before Dawn rewards the player with Ashsight.
dlg-town-crier.md: From 07:00 to 08:00 on Day 4, Mother Brisk is at the Salt Gate buying salt for the inn.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md: CORIN: The bridge closes when the bell rings. It always has.
YSOLDE: Then I’m done with oaths — yours and mine.
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md: “Out here you’re my sister of the road,” Tamsin tells Ves, though they share no blood at all.
